known.external sheet: the header colour comes: var() is not substituted in the cascade that draws the page (Rendering/Style.lean). Owner: css-values.
known.custom property: a script reads --gap: custom properties are not kept by the cascade. Owner: css-values.
known.selector: a child combinator rule sets a: the render cascade's selector reader (Style.lean) knows the descendant combinator only; DOM/Selectors.lean is not used. Owner: pages.
known.flex: three equal items in a row with a: no flex layout on main (and the rule's child combinator is not read). Owner: layout.
known.grid: three columns, two rows: no grid layout on main. Owner: layout.
known.media query: a block that holds applies: getComputedStyle reads the sheets with no viewport (WebDocument.measure), so a min-width block does not hold for it though the layout applies it. Owner: integration.
known.media query: matchMedia agrees with the: matchMedia is a stub in prelude.js that answers false. Owner: css-values.
known.position: absolute in a relative box: no positioning in the layout on main. Owner: layout.
known.box-sizing: border-box: box-sizing is not in the layout profile. Owner: css-values, layout.
known.values: calc(), rem and em lengths: calc(), rem and em are not read by Style.length. Owner: css-values.
known.selector in the cascade: child combinato: the render cascade's selector reader (Style.lean) does not read this selector; the rule is dropped. Owner: pages.
known.selector in the cascade: next-sibling co: the render cascade's selector reader (Style.lean) does not read this selector; the rule is dropped. Owner: pages.
known.selector in the cascade: attribute selec: the render cascade's selector reader (Style.lean) does not read this selector; the rule is dropped. Owner: pages.
known.selector in the cascade: :not(): the render cascade's selector reader (Style.lean) does not read this selector; the rule is dropped. Owner: pages.
known.selector in the cascade: :first-child: the render cascade's selector reader (Style.lean) does not read this selector; the rule is dropped. Owner: pages.
known.selector in the cascade: :nth-child(): the render cascade's selector reader (Style.lean) does not read this selector; the rule is dropped. Owner: pages.
known.selector in the cascade: :is(): the render cascade's selector reader (Style.lean) does not read this selector; the rule is dropped. Owner: pages.
known.form: a click on the button submits the: new FormData(form) is refused ("forms are not supported in this build"): the Fetch objects are not joined to the form entry list of DOM/Forms. Owner: dom-html, net.
known.image: an img takes the size of its file: an img has no complete, naturalWidth or load event: the images the engine holds are not visible to scripts (and the runner fetches none). Owner: pages.
known.transition: opacity runs to its end and: CSS transitions are not on main (the animation engine is on wip/css-anim-values). Owner: css-anim.
